title: Design System: Axiom 数学研究平台

sources.purpose: Effective cascade, approved product override and mobile reader fix.
Approved product constraints and identity commitment.
Approved canon direction and implementation surface brief.
User-approved library and reader organization reference.

display.purpose: Workbench heading 36px/1.4, mobile 29px; direction detail 36px, mobile 29px.

headline.purpose: Module heading; mobile override is 28px. Administrator heading is 32px/1.4, mobile 28px.

title.purpose: Section and stage titles; book and document titles retain their content-specific sizes.

body.purpose: 16px baseline; long introductions often use 1.8 line-height and 65ch/75ch limits.

label.purpose: 14px baseline, preserving readable controls and metadata.

math.purpose: Mathematical notation only; PDF retains source document typography.

shadows.name: auth-flat
shadows.purpose: Authentication panel and active tab have no shadow.

focus.name: composer
focus.purpose: Focus-within on integrated AI input; textarea outline is delegated to the surrounding frame.

focus.name: reader-drag
focus.purpose: Visible drag handle only on hover, focus or active dragging.

motion.name: document-scroll
motion.purpose: Existing page scrolling; reduced-motion changes it to auto.

motion.name: morphicons
motion.purpose: Preserve incumbent hover/focus morph interaction and its reduced-motion behavior; no new timing system.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respect existing reduction preferences for scrolling and Morphicons.

responsive.application: 216px fixed charcoal navigation, 60px topbar, max-width 1280px content; horizontal navigation and stacked home/detail at 900px; 20px mobile gutters at 650px.
responsive.administrator: 216px charcoal rail; max-width 1700px content; records left, 360px editor right; 300px editor at 1100px; single column in DOM order at 800px.
responsive.reader: Desktop grid minmax(0,1fr) 6px var(--reader-notes-width,380px); desktop drag geometry unchanged. Mobile preferred initial notes width 184px, bounded by available width and persisted preferences. Default closed outline. Right panel spans full height, notes default 35% with existing vertical drag.
responsive.aiHeader: At 650px wrap header, move actions to a full-width row and make provider select 92px; no control removal.
responsive.composer: Two actions remain a vertical column at right. Below 200px container width, action column is 48px and gap 4px.
responsive.markers: 30 columns of 28px with 4px gap, more control in column 31; overflow confined to marker strip.
responsive.home: 1.2fr / 0.8fr application and direction areas; 44px gap, 28px at 1100px; one column at 900px.
responsive.direction: Horizontal index rows. Detail: 240px sticky intro and stage textbooks, 210px intro and single language column at 1100px; one column with static intro at 900px; index illustration retained at left on mobile.
responsive.library: Search/button main row; three category fields second row. Catalog five columns: 42px minmax(0,1fr) 130px 62px 150px, 18px gap; narrower columns at 1100px. At 650px headings hidden, metadata and action stacked in column 2; category fields two columns plus full-width last field.
responsive.authentication: Centered logo and login/register module only; white surface, 430px maximum, no panel/tab shadow, underlined active tab.

narrative.overview:
用户确认的 canon 方向结合内容排版的清晰、控件的精确和文献组织的秩序。白色正文、炭灰导航、炭黑文字与克制的靛蓝操作色形成安静、可信、适合长时间阅读的工作空间。参考 [Notion](https://www.notion.com/)、[Linear](https://linear.app/) 与 [Zotero](https://www.zotero.org/) 的方向由用户确认；这里使用自己的品牌与现有组件，不复制其资产。

内容通过标题、段落留白、列表和细分隔线组织，操作通过适度圆角、清晰状态和可见焦点表达。沿用用户确认的连笔 Axiom 字标及“公理”副标题；品牌是 SVG，数学插图是现有代码图形，本轮没有新增栅格素材。Morphicons 沿用既有互动实现。
keyCharacteristics: 用户与管理同一视觉语言

rules.name: The Content First Rule
rules.body: 颜色区分操作、状态与正文层次；阅读器静止分界不能成为占据空间的色带。高亮黄、蓝、粉沿用各自标注语义，方向图形的局部色彩不升级为全站操作色。

rules.name: The Readable Text Rule
rules.body: 不通过缩小正文或辅助文字换取密度；PDF 和数学公式按原文排版与缩放处理。

rules.name: The Continuous Paper Rule
rules.body: 阅读器独立于普通内容容器，占满可用高度，PDF 直达底部。目录默认关闭；标题行只保留目录、适合宽度、全屏操作。右侧笔记与 AI 同层延伸全高，桌面列为 PDF、拖动热区（6px）、右侧面板；桌面宽度及上下拖动几何沿用现有实现，笔记初始比例（35%）。手机右侧笔记优先初始宽度（184px），仍受可用空间与已保存尺寸约束。手机 AI 标题允许换行，来源控件收窄，操作行占满下一行。

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: 平坦内容是默认状态，阴影仅沿用现有状态提示，不成为每个区域的装饰。

dos: Do 从最终有效 CSS 提取与维护规范 token，更新文档时同步 sidecar。
Do 保持正文和辅助文字的可读基准，使用留白与层次组织密度。
Do 保留连续白色阅读表面、可见键盘焦点及减少动画偏好。
Do 使用现有 Axiom SVG 品牌、数学图形和 Morphicons 互动。
Do 根据已有内容与操作构建组件，让真实文献信息承担页面层次。
donts: Don't 恢复旧宋体展示标题、深蓝画布或多层浮起卡片体系。
Don't 在 PDF 与侧栏之间添加静止色带、页阴影或底部占高的状态栏。
Don't 改变 30 标记一行、默认关闭目录、右侧双竖排操作或桌面拖动几何。
Don't 为视觉填充新增统计、上传入口、未实现应用或栅格素材。
